description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gyre Sage's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.name: Experiment Kraj
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it
